question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05a374fb3cb145193d24ad2c4c33d3fa66e42172312f8b08400368f56f0eb42f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second figure is formed by taking the vertical mirror image (water image) of the first figure.

The first pair:

The top element shifts to the bottom after vertical inversion.

The middle horizontal line remains unchanged.

The bottom element shifts to the top after vertical inversion.

The second pair:

The hollow circle at the top moves to the bottom and points downward.

The middle horizontal line remains unchanged.

The upward arrow at the bottom moves to the top and becomes downward.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8f3ce4fe093b42e2d18210c21d84eb4e219ae492209248ec574dc293d79376.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
